momentum.label: Momentum
momentum.blurb: Twelve-month return skipping the most recent month (12-1). The oldest and most robust cross-sectional anomaly; the skip steps over short-term reversal.

ewmom.label: Momentum (exp-weighted)
ewmom.blurb: Toraniko's momentum: exponentially weighted compound return over 504 days with a 126-day half-life, lagged 20 days. Slower and smoother than 12-1.

reversal.label: Short-term reversal
reversal.blurb: Minus the past month's return. Liquidity provision: last month's losers bounce. The fastest factor and the most cost-sensitive.

value.label: Value
value.blurb: Cheapness: the average of standardised log book-to-price, log sales-to-price, cash-flow-to-price and earnings-to-price, each winsorised at 1%.
value.literature: Fama & French (1992); toraniko styles.factor_val (book, sales, cash flow)

quality.label: Quality
quality.blurb: Profitable, conservative, stable: return on equity, gross profits over assets, minus accruals, minus leverage, minus earnings variability, standardised and averaged.
quality.literature: Novy-Marx (2013); Asness, Frazzini & Pedersen (2019) QMJ; Sloan (1996)

investment.label: Investment
investment.blurb: Minus one-year growth in total assets. Firms that grow their balance sheet fastest earn less (the CMA factor).

size.label: Size
size.blurb: Minus log market value in USD: long the smaller names, short the largest, within the liquid universe the ADV floor leaves.
size.literature: Banz (1981); Fama & French (1993) SMB; toraniko styles.factor_sze

lowvol.label: Low volatility
lowvol.blurb: Minus trailing 252-day return volatility. Long the quiet names, short the wild ones; dollar-neutral, so the book carries a negative beta by construction.
lowvol.literature: Ang, Hodrick, Xing & Zhang (2006); Blitz & van Vliet (2007)

lowbeta.label: Low beta
lowbeta.blurb: Minus the 252-day beta to the market's cap-weighted return. Betting against beta, unlevered: the dollar-neutral version is short the market.

dividend.label: Dividend yield
dividend.blurb: Trailing twelve-month dividends over price. The income tilt of value.

construction: universe guards, daily: 252 days of history, ADV floor in USD, market-value floor in USD, price floor in quote units, traded on 90% of the last 63 sessions, one share class per issuer
return-based factors: each name's daily return capped at 5 trailing sigma before the indicator; characteristic factors winsorised at 1% per date
top 30% long, bottom 30% short by rank
equal weight within a leg, dollar neutral, 5% per-name cap redistributed
sector-neutral: ranked and balanced within each sector (groups under 5 pooled); plain: net sector exposure capped at 10% of gross
inverse-vol variant: names sized by 1/vol inside each leg, legs re-balanced
XSVolTarget 10% on the book's realised PnL, 126-day window, 5x cap, 10% deadband, lagged
costs: commission + half spread on turnover, stamp/FTT where it falls, borrow on the short notional
caveats: survivorship: Yahoo serves today's listings only
fundamentals: 4-5 annual statements per name, so value and quality start around 2021
publication lag: a per-market convention (60-90 days) until the point-in-time archive has history
borrow: a flat per-market rate; eligible lists are not public feeds
sector map: Yahoo's sectors today, applied to all history
tier 3 markets: the short leg cannot be traded; the book is a measurement
